emotion: Excited and surprised, eyes wide, front paws lifting

text: They look like so much fun! Do you want to try?
translation: 看起来真好玩！你想试试吗？
emotion: Cheerful and inviting, one wing pointing at the swings

translation: 想呀！我最喜欢荡秋千了！

emotion: Kind and generous, gesturing to the empty swing seat

text: Thank you, Jacky! You’re so nice!
emotion: Warm and grateful, looking up at the chick

text: You’re welcome! Push me when it’s my turn!
translation: 不客气！轮到我的时候，帮我推一下哦！
emotion: Easy and playful, stepping behind the swing

text: Wheee! This is so much fun!
emotion: Joyful, swaying gently on the seat, paws holding the chains

text: Can I have a turn now?
translation: 现在可以轮到我玩了吗？
emotion: Polite and hopeful, small wing raised
Happy and generous, slowing down the swing
Delighted, hopping once, thanking his brother by name
Warm and certain, looking at his big brother
